item.title: 🎙 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at a meeting with President of Eritrea Isaias Afwerki on the sidelines of
item.description: 🎙 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at a meeting with President of Eritrea Isaias Afwerki on the sidelines of the Third Russia–Africa Summit (Moscow, October 30, 2026) 💬 Vladimir Putin : Let me begin by thanking you for taking part in the #RussiaAfrica Summit . Thanks in part to your participation, I believe we have achieved good results . Today, we have an opportunity to discuss our bilateral relations, as Russian-Eritrean relations are progressing . ☝️ We must , of course, pay greater attention to trade and economic cooperation and discuss measures to increase bilateral trade. We see promising opportunities in energy, mining, infrastructure, agriculture and fisheries . We are helping to strengthen your food security. 🇷🇺 🇪🇷 Russia and Eritrea share common positions on many pressing international issues . Mr President, we are, of course, grateful to you for supporting Russian initiatives at the UN and other multilateral platforms. We see this and, I would like to stress, fully appreciate it. We have already worked productively together during the Summit . Once again, we are pleased to have this opportunity to discuss our bilateral ties and their further development . #RussiaEritrea

🎙
Remarks and answers to media questions
by Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov following the G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting
(Atlanta, October 30, 2026)
💬
Sergey Lavrov:
We support
the US Presidency’s
firm commitment to
depoliticising discussions
and focusing on the issues originally agreed upon as the
#G20
’s agenda.
This year’s meeting is, of course,
part of the preparations for
the Miami Summit
, which will take place in December.
The main topics were
the impact of geopolitics on economic processes
(an important issue),
energy
,
food and supply chains
– in other words, everything affected by unlawful sanctions and Western policies.
To our American hosts’ credit, they
do not shy away
from discussing these matters and
listen attentively
. I do not know to what extent this will be reflected in the final agreed documents, but the approach is right:
☝️
depoliticise discussions and focus on real problems
.
Another point that US Secretary of State
Marco Rubio
particularly emphasised when discussing preparations for the Miami Summit was that
twenty countries, the European Union and the African Union
are represented here. Given the influence of
#G20
members on the global economy and their combined economic weight, however,
the decisions we take will affect virtually every country
. We must always bear this in mind.
🤝
Let me reiterate that we welcome this firm commitment to dialogue
.
Work on
the Miami Summit’s outcome documents
has, in fact, already begun.
There will be many difficult issues
, since interests are at stake across all these areas, including energy and food security. The impact of conflicts, including
the war unleashed against us by the West through the Ukrainian regime
, remains to be discussed. <...>
***
Other key points
:
• Under the pragmatic
US Presidency
of the
#G20
, we believe
there is a chance of reaching agreements that will be implemented
.
•
We see no need to add another European voice
[Poland]
to the G20
, especially one that is
far from constructive
. You know the positions Poland regularly voices at international events. The G20 must reflect actual trends in the global economy, where
countries of the Global South and East
are gaining prominence.
• We spoke [with US Secretary of State
Marco Rubio
] about
certain aspects of our bilateral relations
and cooperation in multilateral forums, including the
#UN
, the
#G20
and
#APEC
, that
will host a Summit shortly
in Shenzhen (China).
• Despite all our differences,
the US willingness and interest in pursuing dialogue
at various levels and through a range of other channels
can only be welcomed
. This is a good lesson for our European colleagues, who persist in their
arrogant boycott
.
• Everyone can see that
the Europeans
want to squeeze their way
into the negotiating process
[on Ukraine]. Clearly, they want to avoid leaving these negotiations solely to Russia and the US at all costs. What matters is not what the Europeans want, but
what added value they can actually bring
.
• As for the talks in Abu Dhabi, I can say that
they will take place
. Our position is well known.
It is unclear
, however, what the Ukrainians intend to bring to the negotiating table.
👉
As President Vladimir Putin has said
, if Zelensky wants a meeting,
he can come to Moscow
. We guarantee his safety and security, which, as far as I understand,
cannot be guaranteed in Kiev
.

item.title: ⚡️ Russia's High Commissioner for Human Rights Yana Lantratova Our humanitarian mission in
item.description: ⚡️ Russia's High Commissioner for Human Rights Yana Lantratova : ❗️ Our humanitarian mission in #Alyoshki has concluded . The convoys are now heading to their respective destinations . Those who decided to leave for Ukraine have been given the opportunity to do so. We will provide accommodation and the necessary support to residents staying in Russia . We delivered all the essential supplies and arranged safe passage out of the city . However, people still have much to resolve – medical treatment, housing, documents and reunification with their loved ones. We will help them. We also remain in contact with those who stayed in Alyoshki to keep track of their further needs. *** ❗️ I propose making humanitarian missions coordinated by US First Lady Melania Trump a regular practice . Our experience in Alyoshki and our joint work with my counterpart Dmitry Lubinets have shown that such agreements make it possible to help people even in the most difficult conditions . It is important to continue this work wherever civilians are waiting for support. I thank President of Russia Vladimir Putin , our Defence Ministry , the relevant services and our military personnel for helping carry out the mission and ensuring people’s safety. 🙏 Special thanks go to Melania Trump for her assistance and coordination.
